conf.description: NetFlow/IPFIX options / other: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: netflow / options / other. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (NetFlow Records integration (filebeat netflow input)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
